newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Parliament to vote on Portugal budget on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Parliament to vote on Portugal budget on Friday.

text.p: Portugal's parliament said on Wednesday that the final vote on the minority Socialist government's 1997 budget plan will be held on Friday.

Approval for the plan, which the government says is crucial to Portugal's chances of qualifying for the European Union's planned single currency, is guaranteed after two opposition parties announced they would abstain.
The Socialists are four seats short of a majority in the 230-seat chamber but only the Communist Party, with 15 representatives, has said it will vote against the budget.
